summary: Thread-safe wrapper around the low-level stream read helper sub_5886A7. Takes the stream critical section via StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection(a4), performs the read (arguments a1-a3 forwarded unchanged plus the same lock token a4), releases the critical section via AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave(a4), and returns the number of bytes read. Called from file-enumeration, telemetry, resource, buffer and conditional-dispatch paths, so it is the common locked read entry point for the file/stream layer.

local_names.a1: destination buffer (forwarded to the inner read helper)
local_names.a4: stream/buffer handle used as the critical-section token
local_names.v4: return value of the inner read helper

operations.description: StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection(a4) enters the critical section protecting the stream addressed by a4
sub_5886A7(a1, a2, a3, a4) performs the actual read while the lock is held; its return value is saved
AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave(a4) releases the critical section after the read completes
Returns the byte count produced by the inner read helper

unresolved: The inner reader sub_5886A7 (0x005886A7) is not reconstructed here, so the exact meaning of a1-a3 (buffer, size, offset) is not established by this packet
